Subject: SOC2 alignment & evidence schedule (audit logs, retention, pen test)

Hi Daniel / FinBridge security team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Short recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. High level takeaway: FinBridge needs production-grade evidence and controls coverage for SOC 2 scoping (audit logs + retention), a clear DPA timeline, and a pen-test window that won't impact your peak billing days.

Pain points you called out:
- Audit log retention policy is currently 90 days for transactional logs and you need 12 months for merchant-level investigations.
- Pen-test timing: internal change freeze windows in mid-Jan and late-Jun; prefer external testing in Feb/Mar.
- DPA & data residency: procurement needs a signed DPA + a discussion about log retention controls before contract signature.

Goals we agreed on:
1) Provide a mapped evidence package that ties Redwood controls to the SOC 2 criteria FinBridge cares about (logging, access, encryption, retention).
2) Confirm audit log retention options (12/24/36 months) and any tiered pricing/impact.
3) Lock in a pen-test window that works for both teams and confirm Redwood’s scope and service constraints.

Proposed immediate asks from FinBridge (please confirm by EOD Wed):
- Primary security contact for artifact intake (person + email).
- Preferred pen-test months (Feb/Mar or May/Jun) and any blackout dates.
- Any existing evidence templates or special controls the auditor wants included.

What Redwood will deliver by Dec 13:
- An evidence mapping workbook (attached: RB_evidence_intake_template.xlsx) that lists artifacts, owner, expected delivery date.
- A SOC 2 controls coverage spreadsheet showing where audit logs, retention and pen-test artifacts live (attached: RB_SOC2_Mapping_v1.xlsx).
- A short pen-test scope summary and recommended windows (attached: RB_pen-test-summary.pdf).

Next step: if that timeline looks good I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30-min artifact intake on Dec 15 to walk through the workbook. Also attaching the DPA redline link (I’ll follow up with a DocuSign for signature once we agree on retention).

Thanks — appreciate the clarity on priorities.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0193

Evelyn — thanks for the clear recap. Quick confirmations from FinBridge: 

1) Primary security contact for artifact intake will be Anita Lopez (anita.lopez@finbridge.com). She will own evidence collection and coordinate with our internal auditor.
2) Preferred pen-test window: Feb 15–28. We can accommodate Feb but please confirm Redwood’s recommended testing approach for live inference endpoints (scope: hosted API endpoints only, exclude any customer-managed private deployments).
3) Retention: procurement wants an option for 12 months as baseline and a separate quote for 24 months. If there are any compliance implications for e-discovery we need those surfaced.

We’ll review the attachments today and come back with any immediate gaps. One ask from our auditor — can you produce a short statement on where the audit logs are stored (region), how long key rotation logs are retained, and if there’s an immutable copy option?

Thanks — Daniel

Hi Daniel / Anita —

Thanks — looping in our engineering controls lead (Ben) for the technical mapping. A few clarifications and what we can commit to right now: 

Evidence & mapping (deliverable by Dec 13):
- We will populate the RB_SOC2_Mapping_v1.xlsx with artifact locations, retention policy, and sample queries for audit logs. Each row maps to a SOC 2 CC or common criteria.
- Audit log storage: hosted customers' logs are written to our encrypted S3 buckets in us-west-2 by default; we can support EU regions for private deployments (we noted FinBridge wants US). Logs are versioned and tagged by tenant id.
- Immutable copies: we can provide an immutable snapshot export (WORM-style) on request — that typically adds 2–3 business days to evidence delivery.

Retention options & impact:
- Baseline: 12 months — no code change required; we can enable via config and update the DPA.
- Extended: 24 months — requires additional storage allocation; we’ll include a pricing delta in the quote.
- E-discovery: we can provide tenant-scoped exports and a standard export template. If your auditor needs chain-of-custody signing we can include checksums and a signed manifest.

Pen-test scope suggestion:
- Scope: hosted API endpoints (production inference) — exclude customer-managed Private deployments unless explicitly requested.
- Recommended approach: a staged test (non-blind) where Redwood provides a short runbook for detection/mitigation and a 48-hour agreed-upon remediation window for medium-low findings before re-test.
- Availability: we can support Feb 15–28 as requested but will need a signed test authorization and a short pre-test checklist 10 business days before the start date.

Requested items from FinBridge to proceed:
- Signed test authorization form (we’ll send a template).
- Confirmation of the retention baseline (12 months) and whether you want the 24-month quote.
- Any auditor-specific evidence formats (e.g., CSV exports vs. pre-signed S3 links).

I’ve attached a short mapping sample in RB_SOC2_Mapping_v1.xlsx and the pen-test summary. Ben — can you add the KV cache retention note and the precise S3 paths to the mapping by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks — I’ll set up the Dec 15 artifact intake invite once we have Anita and Daniel’s availability.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Product Security Liaison | Redwood Inference
